Hunters Estate Agent is honoured to present this very fine end-of-terrace two-storey over garden-level period residence. The property has been architect-owned and designed with conservation at its heart and has been tastefully modified and redesigned to create a residence of true distinction. The garden level has been laid out as an own door two-bedroom garden apartment with easy access through a Mediterranean-style, gated courtyard with full morning sun.

Number 37 which is positioned on the westerly side of Waterloo Road, is approached via a gravel and flagstone path, with granite steps lead to the hall door. The property presents light-filled interiors and rooms of gracious proportions, and a wealth of period features are preserved throughout. 

In the main house, a welcoming reception hall leads to the two principal reception rooms with attractive fireplaces and ornate plasterwork and ceiling roses. The guest WC is neatly positioned beneath the stairs whilst the kitchen resides in the return with a wonderful, cantilevered full-height box window feature and dining patio immediately outside. 

Rising to the first-floor return, there is a bright double bedroom whilst a family bathroom completes the accommodation at this level. The principal bedroom spans the full width at the front of the property with a cleverly concealed en suite within the fitted wardrobes. Another double bedroom overlooks the rear garden. A second-floor return was added during the architectural re-design, providing a unique fourth double bedroom, with a balcony that enjoys views of the Dublin Mountains.

The balanced internal accommodation is complemented by the landscaped, mature front and rear gardens. There is off-street parking for two cars to the front with storage for bicycles and bins. The west-facing rear garden enjoys the evening sunshine and offers a sun-dappled patio for alfresco dining. 

Waterloo Road is a much sought-after road in the heart of Dublin 4. Within a gentle stroll of Upper Baggot Street, and equally as accessible to the villages of Ranelagh and Ballsbridge, the property enjoys a wide selection of specialist shops, restaurants, and leisure facilities a short stroll away. Some of Dublin’s most sought-after schools are within easy reach and include St. Mary’s on Belmont Avenue, Muckross Park, Sandford Park, Gonzaga, Alexandra College to name but a few. St Stephen’s Green is a mere stroll away and the RDS, Aviva Stadium, the National Concert Hall and Trinity College are all within easy reach. The 32-acres of Herbert Park is just a stroll away offering pleasant walking routes and playing fields. The convenience of this location cannot be overstated with every amenity on your doorstep as well as the LUAS at Ranelagh providing easy access to both Dublin city centre and south to Dundrum Town Centre and beyond. 

Viewing is essential and highly recommended.

ENTRANCE HALLWAY
1.82m x 8.80m
Original varnished timber floors, ornate ceiling cornicing, ceiling rose, and fan light. Fitted shelving and door to the two principal reception rooms. Guest WC and storage under the stairs. 

GUEST WC
WC and wash-hand basin.

DRAWING ROOM
4.29m x 4.66m
Original varnished floors, ceiling cornicing, period light fitting, ceiling rose and wooden shutters. Attractive marble fireplace and marble hearth. Opening into the dining room.

DINING ROOM
3.90m x 3.99m
Ceiling cornicing, original varnished floors, and attractive wooden fireplace with marble hearth and tiled inset. Concealed jib door, in keeping with the Georgian tradition of maintaining elegant formal rooms. 

KITCHEN/BREAKFAST ROOM
4.68m x 4.15m
The kitchen is fully fitted with an extensive range of wall and base units and quality appliances, including a Siemens ceramic hob, a Miele oven, and a stainless-steel sink. The sale also includes a freestanding Bosch dishwasher, washing machine, tumble dryer, and a side-by-side Liebherr American-style fridge and freezer. A notable feature is the cantilevered box window with dining patio immediately outside and steps to the rear garden below.

FIRST FLOOR RETURN

BATHROOM
1.34m x 1.68m
Fully tiled bathroom with ceiling cornicing. Bath with shower mixer attachment, heated towel rail, WC and wash-hand basin. Hot-press is housed here.

BEDROOM 3
2.97m x 2.65m
Rear aspect room overlooking the rear garden. Original varnished timber floors, fitted shelving and wardrobe, and full-height sash window with working shutters overlooks the rear garden.

LANDING
Large Velux window in the roof allowing an abundance of natural light.

PRINCIPAL BEDROOM
4.71m x 5.41m
Front aspect with double windows overlooking Waterloo Road. Ceiling rose and ceiling cornicing, built-in wardrobes and wooden shutters. Original varnished timber floors and period light fitting.  

EN SUITE
0.9m x 2.23m
WC, wash-hand basin, and shower cubicle. Fully tiled.

BEDROOM 2
3.97m x 3.88m
Rear aspect. Ceiling cornicing, and original varnished timber floors. Wash-hand basin.

SECOND FLOOR RETURN

LANDING
Work-from-home desk sits comfortably here. 

BEDROOM 4
An additional floor was added creating a lovely bright room featuring original varnished timber floors, built-in wardrobes, and a wash-hand basin. A sliding door opens onto a private balcony (2m x 1m), with a desirable south-westerly orientation and panoramic views towards the Dublin Mountains in the distance.

GARDEN LEVEL
Self-contained own-door garden apartment which has a small entrance hallway and two bedrooms. The apartment benefits from approved Accessibility and Inclusive design principles and is all on one level.

BEDROOM 1
2.9m x 4.44m
Laminate floor, ceiling cornicing, large walk-in wardrobe.

EN SUITE (WETROOM)
Newly appointed with WC, wash-hand basin, heated towel rail, and Mira electric shower. It is fully tiled.

UTILITY ROOM
WC, stainless steel sink, plumbed for washing machine and tumble dryer.

OPEN PLAN LIVING/DINING AREA
6.65m x 3.76m
Laminate floor, ceiling cornicing, open fireplace. Exposed brick archway which leads into the kitchen. Patio doors out to the rear garden. Artificial grass extends from the rear door of the garden apartment, providing a low-maintenance outdoor area.

KITCHEN
4.25m x 2.07m
Fully fitted kitchen with wall and base units, stainless steel sink. Ceramic hob with extractor hood, Indesit integrated oven, slimline Ikea dishwasher. Door to second bedroom.

BEDROOM 2
2.98m x 3.45m
Laminate floor, ceiling cornicing, and doors to the rear garden. Wardrobe space and ensuite.

EN SUITE
WC, wash-hand basin, and shower cubicle with Triton electric shower.

REAR GARDEN
6.62m x 14.6m
The beautifully, landscaped, enclosed rear garden is bordered on all sides by original cut stone walls, creating a private and tranquil setting. Raised flower beds, edged with railway sleepers, are complemented by a weeping willow tree, while a charming potting shed is positioned to the rear of the garden. A paved patio provides an ideal space for outdoor entertaining, with steps leading up to a breakfast terrace directly off the kitchen. 

FRONT GARDEN (GARDEN APARTMENT)
A terracotta-tiled patio area creates an attractive Mediterranean-style, gated courtyard which captures the morning sun. It also benefits from storage units, ideal for bicycles and garden equipment, while the gas-fired boiler is discreetly housed here. Off-street car parking for two.

•	Magnificent six-bedroom period residence 
•	End of terrace property extending to approx. 244 sq. m / 2626 sq. ft.

•	Extensive repairs to roof, gutters, chimneys and restoration of granite steps

•	Storage for bicycles and bins
